artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in brown, tan, ochre, olive,and red on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. It features a central wooden cross with a man's figure nailed to it, wearing a crown of thorns and a cloth around his waist. Above the man's head is a plaque with the inscription "INRI." Two other figures with ornate halos stand on either side of the cross. One figure appears to be grieving with bowed head and clasped hands, while the other looks upward. The background includes flora patches, and there are symbolic illustrations in elaborate frames in the image's corners. The style is characteristic of medieval or early Renaissance religious art, focusing on line work and a limited color palette.

artworks.title: Song to the Virgin
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in rose and ochre
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a page from an illuminated manuscript. The page shows musical notation, ornamental illustrations, and Gothic script text. The top has musical notes on a staff. Below, there is Gothic script text with ornate initials. The left side has three small illustrative panels with detailed scenes, possibly of religious or historical figures. The right margin has a floral border. The depiction suggests a religious theme combined with music.

artworks.title: Saint Martin and the Beggar
artworks.medium: woodcut with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures: a man on horseback and a kneeling man. The man on horseback is shown from head to foot, leaning forward, dressed in medieval clothing, with short hair, a halo, and holding a sword. The kneeling man is on his knees, partially covered with a cloth. In the background, there are trees and a building with a triangular roof. The scene is framed with an ornate border.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in green, blue, vermilion, rose, pale orange, and red on vellum
artworks.description: This is a painting of a crucifixion scene. The painting features a central figure on a wooden cross, set against a landscape that includes rolling green hills and a distant city with towers and red roofs. To the left and right of the central figure, there are two haloed figures clad in blue and red robes. Above the scene, celestial elements like the sun and moon are illustrated, each with expressive faces. Surrounding the central scene are roundel enclosures containing animals and additional figures. The entire scene is bordered with a vivid red outline. It is in the style of Medieval European religious art.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.medium: hand-colored woodcut
artworks.description: This is a painting of a crucifixion scene surrounded by floral motifs. The painting depicts a central crucifixion figure on a wooden cross, adorned with a crown of thorns. Below the cross, figures appear to be mourning, dressed in flowing garments of blue and red. The scene is vibrant with a striking use of colors like blue, red, and green, and a background that gives depth to the moment being captured. The frame of the painting is heavily decorated with various types of flowers and foliage, adding an ornamental touch to the composition. This is in the style of an illuminated manuscript or early Renaissance artwork, characterized by its religious themes and elaborate detailed borders.

artworks.title: Saint George (?)
artworks.medium: woodcut
artworks.description: The image shows a figure standing in the center wearing armor reminiscent of a knight. The person is holding a spear and a flag. To the right, an angelic figure with wings is gesturing towards the flag. On both sides of the central figure are two smaller kneeling figures holding staffs with bowed heads. Decorative script at the bottom serves as a border beneath the figures. The background is plain paper, akin to historical woodcut prints. There is a sense of narrative within the scene involving the relationships between the figures.

artworks.title: Saint Catherine of Siena, or Saint Clare of Assisi
artworks.medium: woodcut hand-colored in gray, yellow, and red lake
artworks.description: The image shows a person's upper body in a three-quarter view. The person is seated with their head slightly tilted to the right. They have closed eyes and light-colored hair styled in waves under a gray head covering. They wear a gray robe with a reddish-brown garment underneath. The person holds a closed book with their left hand while a golden halo surrounds their head. The background is plain and light, with a border of multiple gold and black lines framing the image.

artworks.title: Saint Bernardino of Siena
artworks.medium: woodcut
artworks.description: The image shows a standing figure of a man with a halo around his head. His right arm is raised, holding a circular emblem with rays and the letters "IHS" in the center. He has a beard and a bald head fringed with hair, wearing a long robe-like garment with a rope belt. In his left hand, he holds an open book. Around him, there are two kneeling figures on each side, both in dresses with clasped hands. The background features church-like buildings with crosses on their rooftops and a landscape with stylized plants. There are also ornate decorations of bishops’ mitres along a horizontal line, alongside indistinct script above and around the primary figures.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing with a child in her arms. She is shown in a frontal position, holding the child close to her, who is also facing forward. The woman has long, flowing hair cascading down her back, and both she and the child have crowns on their heads. The woman's facial features are illustrated, and her hair appears thick and wavy. She is adorned in a long gown with drapery lines. The gown has folds, adding to the elegance of her clothing. Surrounding her are rays emanating outward. The child in her arms also wears a tunic. Around them, there are three depictions of winged creatures with halo-like circles above their heads, positioned at the corners of the image. These creatures have human faces with serene expressions. The background consists of a simple, unadorned surface.

artworks.title: Joseph and the Christ Child
artworks.medium: engraving, hand-colored in red and green
artworks.description: The image shows two figures standing next to each other. The figure on the right is an older man holding the left hand of the other figure. He has distinct facial features with a prominent nose, gray wavy hair, and a beard. He is wearing a red robe and green mantle, and sandals. In his right hand, he holds a spherical object. The figure on the left is a young child with slightly upturned facial features and short, light hair. The child is dressed in a simple gown and both figures have golden halos. The background is grassy with small plants, and there is a red border. Above the figures is a red banner with the text "Hus," against a clear sky.

artworks.title: Saint Brigitta?
artworks.medium: engraving, hand-colored

artworks.title: Christ as the Man of Sorrows
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a person's body positioned in a sitting pose with their hands resting on their lap. The person has long, wavy hair that falls around their shoulders, and their facial expression is depicted with soft features. They have a serene gaze and a halo depicted around their head. The person appears to be unclothed, revealing the torso. Surrounding them, there's a rich background filled with intricate patterns and symbols, such as a column on the right and various abstract designs in red and gold tones. To the left, there are objects like a hammer and nails depicted. The background is vibrant with a golden hue and intricate detailing that complements the central figure.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child
artworks.medium: engraving, hand-colored in green, yellow, red, and blue on gold background
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to oval shape): 3.1 × 2.8 cm (1 1/4 × 1 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a religious iconic scene. There is a central figure holding a child, surrounded by angels. The central figure has a halo and cradles a child. Two angels appear on either side. The background is vivid with golden hues and radiating lines. The style is late medieval religious iconography, reminiscent of late Gothic or early Renaissance art.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child
artworks.artist: Attributed to Master with the Flower Borders
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.description: The image is a monochromatic illustration depicting two figures, shown from the waist upward. The primary figure is seated, with their body slightly turned to one side, and their head inclined downward to face the second figure. They have delicate facial features and wear a headdress that forms a halo-like circle around their head, adorned with floral patterns. Their hair is partially visible beneath the headdress. They are draped in flowing garments that spread across their seated form in soft folds. The second figure, depicted as a child, is positioned directly in front of the first figure, reaching towards them. The child also has a halo, decorated with lines radiating outward. They are partially wrapped in cloth. The scene is enclosed in a circular border with a decorative geometrical pattern. The background consists of radiating lines emanating from the figures.

artworks.title: The Madonna and Child with a Pear
artworks.medium: engraving, hand-colored in red, orange, green, yellow, blue, and tan
artworks.description: The image shows a woman and a child. The woman is standing, holding the child with her head slightly tilted. She has long, wavy hair, a crown, and is wearing blue and red clothing while holding a heart-shaped object. The child is sitting on her lap, wearing a halo. The background consists of radiating golden lines.

artworks.title: Christ as the Man of Sorrows
artworks.medium: engraving, hand-colored in red, tan, violet, green and flesh; pasted into an initial "O" on an illuminated vellum sheet, torn from a book
artworks.dimensions:
diameter (engraving): 4.2 cm (1 5/8 in.)
sheet: 13.2 × 8.9 cm (5 3/16 × 3 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a painting of an illuminated manuscript page. The centerpiece is a circular miniature depicting an architectural setting, possibly an interior. Within this setting are various objects and text, a ladder, and faces looking inward. The manuscript page features calligraphic text in black ink with highlighted sections in red and blue, and initial capital letters enlarged and colored. The border includes intricate designs with green leaf-like ornamentation and red and blue fleur-de-lis elements. The artistry of the drawing reflects medieval illumination styles. This is in the style of a medieval manuscript illuminator.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child
artworks.medium: engraving, hand-colored in green and red
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to oval shape): 2.7 × 2.2 cm (1 1/16 × 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman holding a child. The woman is standing upright, while cradling the child in her arms. She has an oval face with delicate features and long flowing hair. The child has youthful features and curly hair. The woman is dressed in a layered ensemble, with a red garment underneath and a green robe on top. The child is lightly colored. Surrounding them is a pattern of lines suggesting illumination, with red segments accentuating the background. The backdrop is a flat, textured surface.

artworks.title: Christ as the Man of Sorrows
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.description: This circular print shows a man from the waist up. He faces us, but his eyes are closed and his head is angled downward. He has a straight nose, thin lips, a beard, and medium-length, wavy hair. He is shirtless, with his hands crossed over his abdomen, and there is a hole in the back of his visible hand. A halo is depicted around his head. In the background, there is a horizontal wooden beam that passes behind his head. Above the beam are letters or numerals. In front of and behind the man are diagonal stripes of faint orange, which is the only color present in the print besides the dark lines and tan background.

artworks.title: A Monk with an Angel
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red, olive-gray, light green, olive, blue, yellow, and pink
artworks.description: This print shows two people. One is an angel with large seafoam-green wings and long wavy blonde hair, wearing a red robe. They are floating in the air with one arm raised upwards and the other resting on the head of the second person, who kneels below them on the ground. The other person is a monk in a light brown robe with a hood resting on their back, holding an open green book in their right hand with their left hand extended outwards, the palm facing up. Both people are turned towards the right, and both have pale skin with slightly rosy cheeks. The sky behind them is beige, and the ground is a dark yellow color with some thin horizontal lines.

artworks.title: Saint Veronica with the Sudarium
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in yellow, blue, red, green and gold on laid paper
artworks.description: The image portrays an upper body of a woman within a circular frame. She is holding a white cloth with the face of a man printed on it. The woman has a halo, outlined facial features, wavy shoulder-length hair under a white veil, and wears a blue garment with a red and white shawl. The face on the cloth is of a bearded man with long dark hair, a solemn expression, and marks on the forehead. The circular image is surrounded by vibrant floral designs, including red and purple flowers with green stems and leaves against a reddish background. The outer circle has a golden-yellow hue, and the edges are framed in black on aged, off-white paper.

artworks.title: Saint Valentine, Saint Stephen and Saint Maximilian
artworks.medium: color woodcut
artworks.description: The image shows three figures standing next to each other from head to toe. The central figure is Stephanus, with curly hair and a halo, dressed in a red robe and holding a palm frond and a stone-covered disk. To Stephanus's right is Valentinus, also with a halo, wearing a mitre and a long cloak, holding a crosier. On Stephanus's left is Maximilianus, also wearing a mitre and a halo, with two fingers raised as a gesture of blessing. The figures are dressed in ecclesiastical garments of red, green, and yellow. Below them are three coats of arms with various designs, and the background features a decorative floral border at the top.

artworks.title: A Monstrance Held by Two Angels
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in green, brown, rose, and olive
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two angelic figures holding a religious or ceremonial object. The image features two winged figures standing on either side of an ornate, vertically elongated structure. The structure is embellished with spires and decorative patterns. The figures are draped in flowing garments and have halos around their heads. The color palette is subdued with earthy tones.

artworks.title: Allegory of the Eucharist
artworks.medium: woodcut in lt. brown, hand-colored in blue, green,orange, and gold
artworks.description: This is a painting featuring a religious scene with symbolic imagery. It includes an altar or pedestal in the center with two figures on either side. There is a red and white pattern on top of the pedestal. Above the figures is a representation of a holy being with a radiant aura and a dove below. Various clouds and abstract shapes, some in reds and blues, surround the apex figure. The color palette consists of earthy tones of brown and beige, with accents of red, blue, and green.

artworks.title: Purgatory
artworks.medium: woodcut
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an angel reaching toward people in flames. It is a woodcut-style illustration in black and white. The image shows an angelic figure with arms extended downward toward figures rising from flames. The drawing is surrounded by ornamental text written in Latin, giving it a historical aesthetic.
